title: ZANARY receipt v1
description: A merchant's proof that an invoice was paid. `body` is the machine-readable claim; `claims` states in words exactly what the body carries, and `discloses` must be empty (an artifact that carries more than its claim is the leak the rig's report-leak property looks for). `signer` + `signature` are the merchant's Orchard spend-authorizing public key and a RedPallas signature over the receipt's own fields; `zanary-report verify-receipt` checks both offline.

label.description: Human label for the artifact in a run, e.g. "receipt 4471".

format.description: Format identifier. Bumping it means the body schema changed.

body.description: JSON text. Machine-readable; its schema is `body_schema` below.

claims.description: What the receipt is meant to prove, in words. Every fact in the body must appear here: verify-receipt checks that the body's txid, amount and invoice id are stated in the claims, and refuses a receipt whose claims contradict its body. Each figure must appear as a whole token — a claim that merely embeds it inside a longer number (invoice 91207 for a body carrying 9120) is a contradiction, not a statement, and is refused.

discloses.description: Anything the artifact carries beyond its claims. Must be empty for a receipt: a non-empty list is excess by construction (report-leak).

signer.description: Hex of the 32-byte Orchard spend-authorizing public key (`ak`) that signed this receipt. Not a viewing key: it reveals no note contents or history.

signature.description: Hex of the 64-byte RedPallas signature (`r || s`) over the receipt's own fields (format, body, claims, discloses) in that order, as JSON.

attestation.description: The issuing wallet's signed statement that the receipt key (`signer`) is its own. Present when the flow attested it; optional to publish. A verifier holding the wallet's UFVK uses it to bind the receipt key to that wallet — without it the receipt is bound to no wallet, which is the privacy property, not a gap.

format.description: Attestation format. A verifier refuses a version it does not know.

receipt_key.description: The attested receipt key (Orchard spend-authorizing key, hex) — the same value as the receipt's `signer`.

wallet_ak.description: The wallet's own spend-authorizing key (hex) making the statement.

signature.description: RedPallas signature by `wallet_ak` over the canonical attestation payload (format, receipt_key, wallet_ak, JSON, fixed order).

invoice_id.description: The merchant's identifier for the invoice this receipt settles.

amount_zat.description: Amount settled, in zatoshis. An integer, never a float: floating point money is a bug.

txid.description: The transaction that paid the invoice, lowercase hex, in the same byte order as the chain's RPC.

memo_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the ZIP-302 memo bytes carried by that transaction. The memo itself is not in the receipt: the payer and the amount are the merchant's business, not a stranger's.
